meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: The binding ultrawork-mode directive. This file IS the directive; read it only when ultrawork mode is requested and the directive is not already in the conversation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让代理切入高强度自主执行模式,按既定指令持续作业
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望代理在无人看护下持续高强度完成任务
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want the agent to keep grinding on long tasks without supervision

howto.what: 启用后 Claude 进入 ultrawork 模式：本轮首行固定输出 `ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!`，先做固定开场流程——登记目标与成功标准、建持久记事本、把计划写入文件并登记待办，再用 curl、浏览器等真实渠道跑出证据。
howto.when: 原文写明，仅在被要求进入 ultrawork 模式、且对话中还没有这条指令时才读取本文件；也就是你要求开启该模式时它才接管。

howto.what_en: With ultrawork mode on, Claude acts as an expert coding agent: each turn opens with `ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!`, then it registers a goal with success criteria, opens a durable notepad, and proves work via real channels with captured evidence.
howto.when_en: Read only when ultrawork mode is requested and the directive is not already in the conversation.

say_en.text: Turn on ultrawork mode and finish this change with captured evidence

say_en.text: Use ultrawork mode to fix this bug, with a provable success criterion
